scope: Iraq medical discovery — University of Baghdad College of Medicine

verifiedFacts.claim: The College of Medicine describes an integrated, body-systems curriculum that links basic medical sciences with clinical practice and community patient encounters.
Baghdad College of Medicine's third-year Clinical Attachment includes 248 practical skill-lab hours and 16 theory hours, covering medical history, examination and procedural skills.
Iraq's National Council for Accreditation of Medical Colleges records conditional accreditation for the University of Baghdad College of Medicine, with the decision issued on 23 January 2020.
The Iraqi Ministry of Higher Education's 2025 university ranking lists the University of Baghdad first among public universities.
